status: rules frozen before new predictions; blind state manifest pending exposure audit

direct_comparison.assignment: symmetry and transition/orbital identity; TBE proximity forbidden
direct_comparison.delta_dftb: S1 only; higher requested states explicitly not applicable

tda_training.selection: training MAE with fixed assignments; nearest 0.9 breaks ties

blind_validation.eligibility: HCNO neutral closed-shell singlets; exclude every molecule with prior MOUSE/FAST-TDA/DeltaSCF predictions in audited local and remote result trees
blind_validation.freeze: molecule/state IDs, geometry hashes, symmetry/family, assignments, model hashes and limits before predictions
blind_validation.blinding: TBE labels segregated from prediction inputs until complete prediction ledger closes
blind_validation.shortfall: report eligible family shortfall; never substitute exposed molecules and call them blind
blind_validation.Rydberg: basis-representation failures retained in coverage denominator

structure.exclusions: Never compare re to R0 or harmonic values to fundamentals without a separate correction
structure.additional_frequency_references: required beyond HNO; archive collection or independent remote CC2/CCSD jobs

anchors: +/-0.01 and +/-0.03 Angstrom along frozen lowest nonrigid native normal coordinate
excited minimum with a new converged DFT ground reference
sensitivity.anchor_weight_precheck: algebraic weighted gaps allowed only for independently stationary vertical parents; no weighted off-anchor PES/Hessian claim
sensitivity.proper_response: reoptimize each perturbed problem and its coupled response; do not average relaxed Hessians
sensitivity.report: energies, structures, curvatures, overlaps, index, continuity, failures; no change of candidate after seeing scores

cost.sizes: freeze >=5 increasing atom/AO sizes before cost runs
cost.checkpoint: resume prior stages; report archived preparation cost rather than rerun solely for timing

publication: Only completed qualified results enter manuscript Results; uncomputed work remains labelled pending
